# Support

DecisionLock is a prerelease open-source project. It has no uptime, incident-response, compatibility, or production-support SLA.

Use GitHub issues for:

- reproducible non-security defects;
- documentation errors;
- narrowly scoped feature proposals;
- design discussions grounded in a concrete use case.

Include the DecisionLock version or commit, operating system, Python version, command, minimal configuration, expected behavior, observed behavior, and relevant redacted logs.

Do not use public issues for vulnerabilities, credentials, private data, or production incident details. Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for security reports.
